patch.description: Status graph: held → pending | confirmed | cancelled; pending → confirmed | cancelled; confirmed → checked_in | completed | no_show | cancelled; checked_in → completed; completed, cancelled, no_show, rescheduled are final. Reschedule = the old booking becomes `rescheduled` and a NEW booking is returned. Permissions: `bookings.write` (owner/admin) for reschedule/cancel; `bookings.write_own` lets a staff member set the status of their own visits only.
